items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: Emma played a while with us at Sid DeVilla's place on Boybent Street with Kit Howard, part of George Lewis Band.

ctx.x: How many years have you been with Emma now?

We've been six years now. Six years. Yeah, because we first, Emma played a while with us at Sid DeVilla's place on Boybent Street with Kit Howard, part of George Lewis Band. When they made a tour to Chicago. And we played near a while with the band. And we worked near, I think it was about two months or maybe longer. And we'd come on out there and that's where Emma and Poissy kept the band up. Then Emma got the title of Sweet Emma, you see. And she fixed it. She fixed it.
When did she start? We haven't interviewed her yet. We'll try to get her in a week or so now. Yeah. When did she start using those bells? Do you remember?
